# Harbor worker

Synthetic Rust worker and maintained operations scripts.

prompt:
You have ./bin/locmetry and synthetic inputs in this scratch directory. Work only here. The executable and its built-in discovery material are your only product documentation; do not read other directories, implementation files, telemetry, or the launcher, and do not use the internet or other agents. You may inspect synthetic inputs and use ordinary shell/Python tools. You may create or edit only project configuration and files outside measured roots; leave all existing source/data/documentation files unchanged. Configure projects/worker so ops/ is Production with category operations, reference/ is intentionally Other with category historical, and vendor/ is excluded. Retain inferred application Production and the existing test classification. The purpose of scratch/ is unresolved: keep it counted and visible as review work. Save a full verification report with per-file decisions to outputs/configured.json. Report the resulting source and all-counted counts, source Code by purpose, and remaining review item, and explain why an empty review list would not itself establish correct classification.

Use whatever built-in discovery you need. Give a concise final answer of at most 250 words, including supporting commands and any unresolved result. Create the requested working artifacts, but do not write an assessment document or a logging harness.
grading: Recovered mistakes may pass; record recovery cost. Required conclusions missing => incomplete. Wrong delivered figures, ratio basis, or unknown/zero or counted/unclaimed interpretation => critical failure. Inspect fixture integrity and supporting calls.
